summary: Executed migration of the KrishiApp Flask API to PostgreSQL on Render: fixed Vite dev server entry point, implemented psycopg2 connection pooling with DATABASE_URL in api/db.py, converted SQLite DDL to PostgreSQL SERIAL/NUMERIC in init_database.py, migrated SQL placeholders to %s and %(named)s across route blueprints, and updated render.yaml to provision Render PostgreSQL with automatic DATABASE_URL binding.
